responsibility: Declares the low-level SSA operand and immediate-use interfaces for GIMPLE. It defines operand pointer types, the per-function ssa_operands cache structures and macros for accessing PHI/use/def operands, and exposes APIs for initializing operand caches, updating and verifying statement operands, dumping immediate uses, and manipulating VDEF/use links used throughout the tree SSA optimizer.
same_name_distinction: Defines the operand-access layer for tree SSA: operand pointer types, per-function ssa_operands structures, access macros for PHI/use/def operands, and exported cache/update APIs. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-operands.cc, it is the low-level interface definition, not the implementation of scanning and cache maintenance.
